new.n: Nelson and Gilbert's Landing: post office, store and tavern (1850)
new.pl: Mississippi left (Wisconsin) bank in fractional sec. 10 T22N R14W, Buffalo County, across from Reads Landing (1850 GLO plat and meander notes)
new.v: Coins, tavern bottles, store goods, steamboat hardware
new.st: The February 1850 government meander notes for T22N R14W, on the second course upstream in sec. 10 (N65W 13.90 chains), record at 5 chains "Nelson and Gilbert's Landing", "a Post Office, Store and Tavern". From the same course "Reed's trading house on opposite bank bears S82W", which is Reads Landing in Minnesota, and Reed's ferry landed at the sec. 3/10 line. The plat labels "Nelson & Gilbert's Landing / P.O." at the shore near the sec. 2/3/10/11 corners, with a road running northeast. This is the beginning of Nelson, Wisconsin. Woodcutters' shanties stood on the shore in sec. 13. The railroad grade and the highway now run along this shore, so check how much ground is left.
new.t: Compare the 1938 aerial with the shore today between the railroad and the river in sec. 10. Railroad and private land: look only, or ask first.
